scope: Error propagation for a declared selector on the frozen positive-weight bank; continuous-policy deployment and absolute-error certification remain separate.

definitions.V_i_a: True terminal reward at bank node i under the declared model and exact action budget; 0<=V_i(a)<=1.
definitions.omega_hat_i: Current positive bank weight. No renormalization is assumed.
definitions.L_hat_i: Maximum numerical reward over the admitted cached reference actions A_ref(i). It is not a certified true lower bound.
definitions.H_hat_i: max(L_hat_i, max of stored numerical upper bounds over actions outside A_ref(i)).
definitions.pi_i: Declared finite-bank selector evaluated at node i, with an admitted same-kind/budget numerical reward; the current common-pool comparison selector differs from the all-raw admitted-reference selector.
definitions.d_i: L_hat_i-V_hat_i(pi_i). Nonnegative when pi_i belongs to A_ref(i). If it is not in that set, use max(d_i,0) for the conservative regret bound.
definitions.u_i: Certified upward error for the COMPLETE H_hat_i envelope, including upper error of cached reference rewards where needed.
definitions.ell_i_pi: Certified lower-side terminal error such that V_i(pi_i)>=V_hat_i(pi_i)-ell_i_pi.

finite_bank_relation.pointwise: max_a V_i(a)-V_i(pi_i) <= g_i + max(d_i,0) + u_i + ell_i_pi.
finite_bank_relation.weighted: sum_i omega_i*regret_i <= G_hat + sum_i omega_hat_i*max(d_i,0) + sum_i omega_hat_i*(u_i+ell_i_pi) + ||omega-omega_hat||_1, using rewards in [0,1].
finite_bank_relation.policy_not_automatically_G: Current common-pool raw selector has measured shortfall1.2948013879722498e-6 from the all-raw numerical reference envelope. Current G alone omits this term.

previous_matched_policy_evidence.source: Parent-provided v60 common-pool selector and old-screen point metadata

all_raw_reference_selector.scope: Argmax of all admitted raw values uses the same numerical envelope; this selector is separate from the four-policy common-pool comparison and is not a complete365-action deployment certificate.

count_once.included_utility_omission: screen adds missing[:,None] into action upper values before constructing G. That represented utility slack is already spent in the envelope; do not add sum omega*missing again. Any omission not covered by the complete envelope must be assigned once to u_i.
count_once.posterior_weights: Either include shared-identity posterior weight errors inside u_i/ell_i_pi, or derive a separate conditional-value propagation bound; do not charge the same score/weight uncertainty again.
count_once.outer_support: Unrepresented outer origin/tail mass is separate from missing utility at a covered node. Count it once, either by extending the weight-error bound with zero numerical weights on omitted nodes or as a separate support remainder.
count_once.fallback_zero: The omitted fallback reward is nonnegative. It does not create additional downward error of the selected action; its cap belongs once to the full-reward numerical/upper-error accounting. P/I numerical rule error still needs a true lower-side certificate.

continuous_distribution.relation: Continuous-policy regret additionally needs risk-outer and objective-outer/F16 propagation for the same regret or selected-policy integrand, plus any outer support remainder not already in the weight term.
continuous_distribution.risk_outer: Old fixed-action 8x16/16x8 comparisons do not certify the current 224-node guard-max/selected-policy integrand.
continuous_distribution.objective_outer: The cached F16 heads do not by themselves provide an objective-outer convergence or absolute-error certificate.
continuous_distribution.rule_controls: Cross-rule differences and predictive log-evidence checks remain diagnostics; they cannot be substituted for u_i or ell_i_pi as absolute-error certificates.

baseline_relation.numerical_policy_contrast: C_hat(pi,355)=C_hat(ref,355)-sum_i omega_hat_i*d_i, using the signed selection difference.
baseline_relation.required_baseline: STOP/debited point values are already available; their strict propagated error certificate is missing. Retain the same model, before/after budget and query/batch contract.
baseline_relation.shared_control_variates: If the SAME numerical 355 quantity is used in both C and D, it cancels algebraically in C-D; propagate the remaining primitive errors rather than charging its error twice. Different baseline evaluations need their residual mismatch controlled.
baseline_relation.query_selection: A value comparison across queries/batches needs each matched continuation/STOP/debit evaluation; the current single-query bank does not supply it.

current_net_point_previews.scope: Point previews only; not net KG absolute-error certificates.

baseline_relation.current_primitive_net_error_relation: For Khat=Chat(pi,355)+Bhat_debited-Shat_STOP, an absolute bound is E_C(pi,355)+e_B+e_S. E_C requires matched selected-action/fixed-action terminal errors and risk/F16/weight propagation. Current baseline uses a separate prior calibration; no numerical355-error cancellation is assumed without a matched shared estimator.
